Definition: perhaps from G1 (as a negative particle) and G1492 (through the idea of downcast eyes); bashfulness, i.e. (towards men), modesty or (towards God) awe:--reverence, shamefacedness.
BiblicalUsage: Once only. Paul says women should adorn themselves with shamefacedness and sobriety — modest dress, with a downcast, reverent spirit, not broided hair or gold or pearls or costly array.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for downcast modesty carries little weight on its own; its force lives in the one verse, where reverence before God shapes how His people dress.
RelatedTopics: Humility; Worship; Fear of the Lord
